# balena_application_profile (Resource)

Activates a profile name of one application on another application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_application_profile" "gpu" {
  application_id    = 1234567
  profile_name      = "gpu"
  on_application_id = 7654321
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the application activating the profile. Must be of class `fleet`.
- `on_application_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the application the profile is activated on. Must be a host application that is not of class `block`.
- `profile_name` (String) Profile name being activated. Must be between 2 and 100 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier assigned by the Balena API.
